brief: The two-mile concrete beach promenade: a broad flat concrete walk with a separate painted bike path, a low white stucco kerb wall and palms on the sand side, and a continuous wall of shops, cafés, stalls and four- and five-storey condo blocks on the other, vendors' stands and crowds along it. Three photos. Resurfaced in the 2000s. Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
